E.headline: All three LLMs showed stronger sentence-structure effects than human groups; GPT-4o’s contrast predictions correlated most closely with human responses.

G.notes: The paper does not report exact model checkpoints, API query dates, decoding settings, or a code/data link. The spoken and written human groups differ by modality, so clarify how the nine model–human comparisons were selected and whether effect coefficients are directly comparable across groups.
